description: Relay the signed physical proof to the same public door any HTTP client uses (POST /labor/work/:workId/physical-proof): pass workId, the BODY_JSON from prepare_physical_proof UNCHANGED, and the signature over MESSAGE_TO_SIGN. FREE with a valid signature from the claiming wallet. It records the photo hashes and the on-site GPS against the packet's 350 m place; a far GPS is flagged for the human, never auto-rejected. NOBODY IS PAID by this call and nothing is accepted: the packet's creator signs the verdict, never the worker.

bodyJson.description: The exact BODY_JSON string from prepare_physical_proof, unchanged.

workId.description: The packet id, the same one prepare_physical_proof was given.
